# Catherine Andrews

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P30](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0030)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Catherine Andrews possesses a plump figure. She was observed moving quickly across a pasture below the beech wood.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P30](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0030)_

## Personality

Catherine Andrews maintains an optimistic outlook on life, consistently striving to look on the bright side of situations. She acknowledges that keeping a positive attitude is necessary for her, particularly given her living arrangement with [Eliza](../character/eliza-andrews.md).

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P21](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0021), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P31](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0031)_

## Traits

- optimistic  <sub>[v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P21](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0021), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P31](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0031)</sub>

## History

Catherine Andrews grew up without going out to halls or social events in her youth, developing an optimistic outlook alongside her dour sister, [Eliza](../character/eliza-andrews.md). During a visit from [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), Catherine and [Eliza](../character/eliza-andrews.md) were solicited for the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village Improvement Society's hall painting fund. Catherine assisted in receiving the girls as they successfully gathered subscriptions along the [Newbridge](../codex/places.md#newbridge) road.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P2](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0002), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P6](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0006), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P11](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0011), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P13](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0013), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P17](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0017), +12 more_
